messages.body_plain:
You cannot add this info to the package version, unfortunately, because R package version strings are very restricted. (I suggested using semantic versioning and/or more flexible version strings on R-devel a couple of months ago, but it was turned down, not sure why.)

It seems that install_github adds info to the DESCRIPTION file, so if you do

> install_github("gaborcsardi/rappdirs@99034163bbbe108207f1bb838ea1630f5846a56b")

you can get what you need from

> packageDescription("rappdirs")
Package: rappdirs
[...]
GithubRepo: rappdirs
GithubUsername: gaborcsardi
GithubRef: 99034163bbbe108207f1bb838ea1630f5846a56b
GithubSHA1: 99034163bbbe108207f1bb838ea1630f5846a56b
[...]

Gabor

messages.body_plain:
Another update. Hope anybody could help me with this issue.

It seems I have isolated two source files in my package R directory which are causing problems. If I take them out, everything goes fine and the documentation is generated. These two files are, curiously, the two using S4 classes. Could this be the point? Maybe I am missing something in my S4 code?

This is what I did: I took one of the wrong files, and created a new package from scratch containing just that file. When I run document() over the new package, everything works smoothly.

What is happening? Could anybody provide a hint?

Here is an excerpt of my S4 documented code:

#'
#' Base AnnotationCommand
#'
#' Abstract class that implements the execute interface for Command Design Pattern.
#'
#' @slot colName Prefix used in order to generate the column name for the annotation.
#'
setClass('AnnotationCommand', representation(colName='character'))

#'
#' getColName generic
#'
#' Generic definition of the getColName getter methods.
#'
#' @param object An object that probably contains a colName slot.
#'
setGeneric('getColName', function(object) standardGeneric('getColName'))

#'
#' AnnotationCommand base implementation of getColName
#'
#' Getter method for colName slot for all AnnotationCommand objects.
#'
#' @param object An AnnotationCommand object.
#'
setMethod('getColName', 'AnnotationCommand',
          function(object) {
            return(object@colName)
          })

#'
#' setColName generic
#'
#' Generic definition of the setColName setter methods.

#'
#' @param object An object that probably contains a colName slot.

#' @param value The new column name.
#'
setGeneric('setColName<-', function(object, value) standardGeneric('setColName<-'))

#'
#' AnnotationCommand base implementation of setColName
#'
#' Getter method for colName slot for all AnnotationCommand objects.
#'
#' @param object An AnnotationCommand object.
#' @param value The new column name.
#' @name setColName
#'
setReplaceMethod('setColName', 'AnnotationCommand',
          function(object, value) {
            object@colName <- value
            validObject(object)
            return(object)
          })

Regards,
Gustavo
